Agent Name: Verification_Expert  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The first clear error is when Verification_Expert replaced the missing real Zillow dataset with a tiny synthetic dataset and then claimed it was “representative” of the real data. That is not a valid verification of the actual problem, because the synthetic sample does not prove the smallest house in Prince Edward Island from Zillow sales between June 1, 2022 and May 15, 2024. The function was only tested on fabricated data, so the conclusion is unsupported for the real-world question.
